title: The anatomy of a rule
objective: Write a rule whose target is report.txt, whose prerequisite is notes.txt, and whose recipe builds the report in two commands.
hint: A rule is the line 'targets: prerequisites' followed by the recipe. Every recipe line must begin with a real TAB character; four spaces are rejected with 'missing separator'.

steps.description: both commands of the recipe run, in order
the first command wrote the header, the second appended the notes
the prerequisite is not newer, so nothing is rebuilt
put the target in the past, so the prerequisite is the newer file
a newer prerequisite brings the rule back to life

lesson.goal: 拆开一条规则的目标、前置条件和 recipe。
lesson.prediction: make report.txt 会先检查 notes.txt，还是直接运行两条命令？
hints: 规则头的形式是 target: prerequisites。
两条 recipe 可以连续写在同一个目标下面。
第二条命令也必须以 TAB 开头。
lesson.explanation: 目标行描述依赖关系，缩进的每一行才属于 recipe。
